purpose: One row shape for every sentiment source. A new corpus, including a dataset from the guide, implements this shape and then gets the same coverage audit. No outcome is computed from a source until its planning SD and threshold conversion are logged.
grain: One row is one document that mentions at least one study node.

fields.node: Study-node name after the source's match rule.
fields.source: Source id, for example fnspid, stocktwits, gdelt, tweetskb, or the guide corpus id.
fields.arm: A or B, or a new arm id. Arms are not pooled.
fields.date: ISO date. The source file states the timezone rule.
fields.document_id: Stable id inside the source. A URL is not stored. A hash is allowed.
fields.score: One document score on the source's logged scale. Null when the document is unscored.
fields.entity_ids: The study nodes mentioned in that document, used to drop the event entity from a target window.

daily_reduction.document_count: Documents that day for the node.
daily_reduction.score_sum: Sum of scores. The daily mean is score_sum / scored_count.
